nodes.text: 旋「峯」消息: 搭東鐵往來羅湖或落馬洲超方便 Travel hassle-free on the East Rail Line to and from Lo Wu or Lok Ma Chau

港鐵網絡覆蓋全港，各區出發，與朋友沿綫集合話咁易，班次亦非常頻密，隨時隨地搭東鐵綫經羅湖或落馬洲站前往深圳超方便。過關後無縫連接深圳地鐵，輕鬆玩勻深圳人氣熱點！立即觀看旋「峯」消息，讓林峯告訴你搭東鐵綫過境有多方便！ 詳情可瀏覽: https://www.mtr.com.hk/ch/customer/main/eal-brand-service-campaign.html #港鐵 #MTR #東鐵綫 #搭東鐵 #羅湖站 #落馬洲站 #深圳 #攻略 #林峯 With MTR’s extensive railway network covering all districts across Hong Kong, it is easy to meet up with friends along the line and travel together. Frequent services on the East Rail Line also make travelling to Shenzhen via Lo Wu or Lok Ma Chau incredibly convenient at any time. After crossing the boundary, you can seamlessly connect to the Shenzhen Metro and explore the city’s most popular attractions with ease! Watch the Cross Boundary Travel News now and let Raymond Lam show you how convenient it is to take the East Rail Line for cross boundary travel! Click the link to learn more: https://www.mtr.com.hk/en/customer/main/eal-brand-service-campaign.html #EastRailLine #LoWu #LokMaChau #Shenzhen #RaymondLam
Seamless Cross Boundary Travel on East Rail Line
一股「小旋風」正於東鐵綫沿綫集結
有市民已急不及待於金鐘上車
請注意,港鐵班次非常頻密
去羅湖及落馬洲都很快有車
接駁深圳地鐵不慴塞車
旋「峯」集結於 4 大轉綫站
往來羅湖最快 3 分鐘 1 班
往來落馬洲最快 6 分鐘 1 班
深圳地鐵 4 或 10 號綫
Seamless Cross Boundary Travel on East Rail Line
MTR's East Rail Line provides frequent and seamless transportation between Hong Kong and Shenzhen.
Take the East Rail Line for convenient cross-boundary travel.
Passengers can enjoy fast, frequent, and weather-proof transit to Shenzhen, with trains running as often as every 3 to 6 minutes.
